title: Reva: Real-Time Vulnerability Detection through Contextual Probing of Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.35829v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A vulnerability costs more to fix the later it is discovered. As coding agents generate code faster than developers can review it, software needs a first line of defense screening each new function in real time. LLM agents have recently become capable of finding real-world vulnerabilities by working as a security expert would: they run analysis tools, explore the surrounding code, test hypotheses and weigh the evidence before forming their own judgement. This reasoning, however, spans many model calls, so that each verdict takes minutes of compute, far too long for real-time screening. Faster detectors, which fine-tune deep learning models or prompt an LLM for a direct verdict, are less accurate: they judge a function without the context an agent gathers, and an LLM's generated verdict is unreliable even when given some of it. translated_title: REVA：通过大语言模型上下文探测实现实时漏洞检测
translated_abstract: 漏洞发现得越晚，修复的成本就越高。随着编码代理生成代码的速度超过了开发人员审查的速度，软件需要一道第一防线来实时筛查每一个新函数。LLM代理最近已经能够像安全专家一样发现真实世界中的漏洞：它们运行分析工具、探索周边代码、测试假设，并在形成自己的判断之前权衡证据。然而，这种推理过程涉及多次模型调用，因此每次判断需要数分钟的计算时间，对于实时筛查来说实在太慢。而更快的检测器——无论是微调深度学习模型，还是直接提示LLM给出判断——准确率都较低：它们在缺乏代理所能收集的上下文的情况下对函数进行判断，而且即使提供部分上下文，LLM生成的判断也不可靠。我们提出了REVA（REal-time Vulnerability Analysis，实时漏洞分析），一种AI漏洞检测器，它将安全专家……
tldr: REVA是一种AI漏洞检测器，通过让大语言模型像安全专家一样进行上下文探测和推理，在保持专家级准确度的同时实现实时漏洞筛查。
